text:
oliver_sales: Handoff: Seraph Care signed a 90-day pilot. PO countersigned. Go-live target 2025-08-11. Requirements: HIPAA BAA, SAML SSO, private control plane in us-east-2 or dedicated pool, 24/7 audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, low-latency during clinic surge windows. Contact: priya@seraph.care. Link to pack: https://drive.red/seraph-pilot

maya_cs: Great 1 I'll own onboarding and be primary customer contact. Quick clarifiers: 1) Do they require Splunk vs generic syslog? 2) Any expectation around log retention >90 days?

oliver_sales: They prefer Splunk HEC but can accept S3 delivery if we need time. They want 12 months retention for audit logs. No inbound model fine-tuning.

devon_support: Opening infra ticket. We need SAML IdP XML, VPC CIDR for peering, Splunk HEC URL + token (or S3 bucket ARN), and signed BAA. ETA to provision private plane: ~4 business days after artifacts.

hana_eng: Perf note: to keep P99 <300ms at expected peaks we should provision a warmed dedicated pool 0700-1700 ET. Need expected concurrent sessions and avg tokens/session to size KV cache. Also ask for a small eval set (~30 prompts) to validate quant variants.

oliver_sales: Expected peak: ~15 concurrent sessions, avg 450 tokens/session, concentrated 8am-4pm ET Mon-Fri.

maya_cs: Action owners drafted: CS: maya_cs (onboard + comms + rollout), Support: devon_support (infra & ticket), Eng: hana_eng (sizing + perf sims), Security: lucy_security (BAA + PHI review), Sales: oliver_sales (contract & pricing). I'll send an onboarding checklist to customer.

maya_cs: Checklist (to share):
```
- Signed BAA (scan/upload)
- SAML IdP metadata (XML)
- VPC CIDR + peering contact
- Splunk HEC endpoint + token OR S3 bucket ARN
- Eval prompt set (30-50 prompts)
- Canary plan (5% -> 25% -> 100%)
- Rollback criteria & SLA measurement plan
```

lucy_security: Request the BAA and their security questionnaire. HSM-backed keys required for private plane; provisioning HSM adds ~3 business days. Also confirm log retention (12 months) will be an add-on charge.

ops-bot: ticket CS-7781 created by devon_support - infra.provision.privateplane

devon_support: Scheduling tech kickoff Fri 2025-07-18 10:00am ET. Placeholder invite sent to internal attendees; will invite customer once artifacts arrive.

hana_eng: I'll run a perf sim after we receive the eval set. Plan: test q8 and q4 quant, measure quality delta on their prompts; if degradation >2% on clinical prompts, recommend non-quant canary. Also will validate KV cache hit ratios given avg session size.

maya_cs: Risk & escalation notes: renewal risk = medium. Pilot length 90 days; main risks are security/legal delays (BAA + HSM) and any sustained latency during surge windows. If infra/security blockers exceed 6 business days, escalate to Head of CS. Weekly health sync cadence (Thursdays) set until pilot end.

oliver_sales: Thanks everyone 1 I'll ask customer for SAML metadata and BAA today and update this thread when they reply.

maya_cs: Thanks 1 I'll compile the internal runbook and post to the shared CS tracker after kickoff.
